text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: So there really isn't... any way to avoid this conflict?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……どうしても、
戦わなくちゃいけないんだね。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
No time to hesitate. We'll never defeat her if we don't give this our all!
We need to win this battle! And then...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
迷いは捨てて。
そうしないとヤツは倒せない！
なんとしてもこの戦いに勝とう！　
そして……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: We will grant... our own wish!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……叶えよう、
私たちの願いを……！
